Stone Edge
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user’s Defense is raised.
Deactivation Condition:
When the user’s Defense is not raised.

Never misses. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. The more the user’s Defense is raised, the greater the power of this attack. The more the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is raised, the more it reduces its sync move countdown (can be reduced by up to [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ] maximum). The more the user’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] is raised, the more it increases its [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="1" ] (can be increased by up to [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ] [EN:Qty Ref="2" S="rank" P="ranks" ] maximum). Removes all of the user’s Defense increases.
